## Summary

What changed and why?

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Frontend build (`cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build`)
- [ ] Relevant regression / manual tests documented
- [ ] No secrets, customer meter data, private URLs, private screenshots, or logs added
- [ ] Security impact / auth boundary reviewed
- [ ] Docs, changelog, release notes updated if relevant

## Deployment and rollback

Does this change require settings, migrations, or operational actions? What is the rollback path?
